# LumenfiteOrb

**Tags:** `item`

A polished lumenfite sphere charged with stored magical energy by an Arcanist. Serves as a portable light source, a spell-focus amplifier, and a key reagent in high-tier enchanting recipes.

> **Goal:** Versatile magical utility item for Arcanists; drives demand for twilight-biome lumenfite
